ache.title: Danjin guide: a risky playstyle, not a risky wallet
ache.note: Nero loved Danjin, a 4-star with risky, HP-burning play who helps Havoc Rover. Honestly, getting excited about a 4-star and the main character you already have is a sweet way to play. The trap is what comes after a guide: more resources, more upgrades, more reasons to log in. Keep the fun part, skip the chasing part.
watch: one guide leading to “build her fully”
upgrade grind that never quite ends
ache.tip: Use the characters you already own and enjoy them. Fun doesn’t need a five-star price tag.
lines: a 4-star you love beats a 5-star you chase
burning HP is fine. burning cash isn’t

title: Character Guide: Danjin | Wuthering Waves
excerpt: I think Danjin is one of the most fun 4-stars, with her risky. hutao-esque HP-focused gameplay. She helps Havoc Rover a lot, making them even more viable, and it'd be fun to use the MC for once. Let me know your opinion about Danjin down in the comments!
